releaseNotes: Follow-up to PR-2's money-domain hub-and-spoke split: a broader re-sweep found four files the original stale-citation cleanup missed, all still pointing at the old pre-split section numbers (§7a/§7b/§8a/§8b) or a filename whose own section meaning changed in the split. Fixed knowledge/process/tool-recipes/revenue-email-analytics.md's §1 sources redirect to point at revenuecat-and-store-products.md rather than revenue-monetization.md, since revenue-monetization.md's own new §1 became the Monetization Decision Matrix, not the sources list; its §8a and §7a citations now name billing-health-and-reactivation.md §2 and paywall-pricing-and-experiments.md §3.

Fixed the remaining three files carrying the same stale §7a/§7b/§9 tokens: validation/business/money/check-revenue.ts (four comment citations renamed to paywall-pricing-and-experiments.md §3/§4), validation/repository/evals/launchbench/paywall-experimentation-never-starts.yaml (§7a/§9 renamed to paywall-pricing-and-experiments.md §3 and revenue-monetization.md §2; §7b renamed to paywall-pricing-and-experiments.md §4), and validation/repository/fixtures/providers-and-secrets.fixtures.ts (two comment citations renamed to paywall-pricing-and-experiments.md §3/§4). A full repo sweep for §7a/§7b/§8a/§8b now returns zero hits, and a broader §9/§10 sweep confirms every remaining hit is a different file's own, unrelated section numbering (post-launch-operations.md §9, aso-store-ops.md §10, localization-market-research.md §7, emotional-experience-measurement.md §9).
